nodes.pendingActionText: Joint measurement, sub-division survey or record-of-rights reconciliation

nodes.pendingActionText: Field verification of titles and mutation entries
nodes.name: Sub-Divisional Officer and Tehsildar, Asifnagar Mandal
nodes.why: Field verification of titles, notices to interested persons and mutation entries at mandal level.

nodes.name: Administrator for Rehabilitation & Resettlement, Hyderabad

nodes.pendingActionText: References on compensation or objections awaiting disposal
nodes.name: Arbitrator appointed by the Central Government (s.3G(5))
nodes.why: Forum for references on objections and compensation under the NH Act, 1956.

nodes.pendingActionText: Fund release or treasury / PFMS clearance pending

nodes.pendingActionText: Registration and mutation of acquired land pending

nodes.why: Acquired land must be registered and mutated in favour of the requiring body before the case can close.

nodes.pendingActionText: Valuation reports for crops, trees or structures pending

nodes.why: Crops, trees and structures on the parcels are valued by line departments before the award.

nodes.pendingActionText: Electricity, water or telecom utility shifting estimates pending
nodes.name: Utility owners — electricity distribution company, water board, telecom (Hyderabad)
nodes.why: Utilities on the alignment must be shifted before the site can be handed over clear of encumbrances.
